visual_action: A montage of clips showing Jerome Powell in various professional settings. He is seen speaking at a podium with American flags and a seal for the Board of Governors behind him, walking away from a podium, speaking in a more casual indoor setting, wearing a hard hat at what appears to be a construction site, and speaking at a congressional-style hearing. The clips are cut together in a rapid sequence.

cast.name: Jerome Powell
cast.evidence: He is the sole subject of the video montage and is referenced in the caption 'in jerome we trust 🫡'.

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The video was posted by the official @democrats account on TikTok.

spoken_summary: The video begins with Jerome Powell saying "Good afternoon." The rest of the audio is a rap song with no further dialogue.
audio_music: The video starts with a man speaking, then a confident, upbeat rap track ('Feeling On My Body' by Taffy/PLUTO) begins and plays for the remainder of the clip, functioning as a hype track for the montage.
editing_pacing: The video is a fast-paced montage with quick cuts between various clips of the same individual in different settings.
cultural_references: The video uses the popular TikTok "edit" or "hype video" format, where clips of a person are set to upbeat music to portray them in a positive or powerful light.
central_claim: Jerome Powell is a competent and trustworthy leader managing the economy effectively.
intended_effect: To generate confidence in and a positive perception of Jerome Powell's leadership of the Federal Reserve, presenting him as a 'cool' and capable figure.
